name: Moving Goalposts

topology.update: criterion fulfilled -> criterion redefined -> obligation remains open

activation: a criterion is presented as sufficient
after fulfilment, a meta-rule changes the criterion retroactively
maintenance: completion never reaches a terminal state
new requirements inherit legitimacy from the previous unmet obligation
signatures: success does not close the obligation
the definition of enough changes after performance
falsePositives: new requirements caused by genuinely new external conditions
open-ended work where sufficiency was never promised
